_comment: Machine-readable catalog of all public JSON endpoints in this dashboard. Any Claude project, agent, or tool with WebFetch can discover and use these.
description: Excavatortron — AI Skills Tracker. Automatically extracts skills, model rankings, tips, news, and connectors from a YouTube playlist. Updated continuously via GitHub Actions.

endpoints.description: All AI skills and techniques extracted from the playlist. Full records with quality scores, compatibility lists, tips, source videos, and star/freeze flags.
Compact skill index — fast lookup by slug. Contains only essential fields (slug, skill_name, category, quality_score, target_tool, starred). Much smaller than skills.json; start here for discovery.
AI model rankings per category (code, agents, writing, etc.). Each category has a podium (top 3) and full_ranking (all models sorted by score).
Claude connectors and MCP servers mentioned in the playlist videos. Includes name, type, provider, what it does, install source, official flag, and quality score.
Practical tips organized by tool (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, etc.) and by general topic (prompt engineering, automation, agents, code, parallel tasks, self-improving systems, harness code).
Master list of AI slash commands (e.g. /review, /compact). Each entry has command name, description, tool, and source video.
AI news from the past 24 hours as mentioned in playlist videos. Entries sorted newest-first with 2-sentence summaries.
AI news from the past 7 days as mentioned in playlist videos.
AI news from the past 30 days as mentioned in playlist videos.
AI news from the past 24 hours pulled from 50 official RSS/Atom sources (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Anthropic-adjacent labs, arXiv, etc.). Updated every 12 hours. No API keys required.
AI news from the past 7 days from 50 official sources.
AI news from the past 30 days from 50 official sources.
Pipeline status and run report. Includes last fetch/analyze timestamps, videos seen, pending count, catch-up mode state, and reliability flags (analyze_ok, analyze_failed_at).
Self-improvement health report: overall score 0-100, metrics (missing summaries, schema issues, duplicates, orphan folders), cadence advice, and pending suggestions count.
Pending improvement proposals from the self-improvement stage (fuzzy merges, rescores, UI changes, star suggestions, dead feed removals). Approved via MCP tools.
Frozen/starred skills — proven best-in-class, never auto-modified. Each entry has slug, reason, and starred_at timestamp.
Auto-created dynamic trend tabs. When 5+ videos converge on a topic not covered by any existing tab, a new tab is created here and announced on the dashboard.
Audit trail of skill merges performed by the analyze and improve stages.
Per-source consecutive failure streaks for the 50 official news RSS/Atom feeds. Sources with fail_streak >= 5 are proposed for removal.
This file — machine-readable index of all available endpoints. Fetch this first to discover what data is available.

how_to_use.for_claude_agents: WebFetch any endpoint URL above. Start with index.json for a fast skill overview (small file), or skills.json for full records. All files are public JSON served over HTTPS — no auth required.
how_to_use.for_mcp_tools: The offline MCP server at mcp_server/server.py exposes 20+ tools (list_skills, search_skills, get_skill, show_models, star_skill, list_suggestions, approve_suggestion, pipeline_status, etc.). Add it to Claude Desktop config for local access.
how_to_use.for_other_agents: All data is served as static JSON over HTTPS from GitHub Pages. Poll status.json to check freshness (last_analyze field). The catalog is regenerated by the self-improvement stage whenever data changes.

update_cadence.fetch: every 48 hours — new videos pulled, transcripts fetched
update_cadence.analyze: every few hours — Claude extracts skills/models/news from pending videos
update_cadence.web_news: every 12 hours — 50 official RSS/Atom sources refreshed
update_cadence.self_improve: every ~3 days — dedup, calibrate, health report, catalog regenerated

suggested_workflow: 2. Check status.json to confirm data is fresh (last_analyze within 6 hours)
3. Fetch index.json for a compact skill overview (~small file)
4. Fetch skills.json for full skill details if needed
5. Fetch connectors.json for MCP servers and Claude connectors
6. Fetch daily_web_news.json + daily_news.json and merge for today's AI news
